quest.title: A Child Wandering the World
quest.description: Inside the witch's dictionary, you discover an unusual message that must be delivered to Durin...
quest.rewards_formatted: Hero's Wit x3, Guide to Ballad x3, Mora x30000

talks.objective: Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Durin! So this is where you've been!

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, the real question is, what are you doing cooped up in here reading a book? The weather's nice out there, y'know?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Oh. Well, ever since I've had more chances to interact with the people of Mondstadt, I've been having trouble telling when people are joking.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: For example, I saw a beautiful flower the last time I was at the florist. So, I told the shopkeeper, and she said:

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: "Hehe, if you like these weeds so much, you should add some Mint and Sweet Flowers, and make it a bouquet."

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: So I did as she said. But when I showed her the finished bouquet, she gave me a frankly terrifying look...

choices.text: You have a unique perspective, Durin.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Later, Albedo opined that this happened because I have trouble understanding the "meaning behind words."

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: So, after I learned the Mondstadt script, he told me I could come here and read.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: I was born from a storybook, so I felt that these books might be able to teach me more about the "rules" of this world.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: And, well, I guess I lost track of time... So, um, did you guys need something?

choices.text: Friends do often drop by just to say hi, Durin.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Oh, I see. That's another rule learned, then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep! That said, we did have business we needed to discuss, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we have a message to pass along from Rhinedottir.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Oh... It... It's from Aunt Rhinedottir?

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: No, I... I'm just surprised. Rhinedottir is my mom's friend... And the mother of the dragon that once existed in my stead.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: I supplanted him — took the fate that should have been his.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: So, if she dislikes me... Well, I'm not sure what I'd do.

choices.text: I don't think she holds it against you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We're here for you! But, seriously, Paimon doesn't think it's anything bad.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: That does make me feel better.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Well, I guess I should open it...

choices.text: So we're here at the Hexenzirkel's behest...
Feels like she's the one with the issue here.

dialogues.speaker: Sebas
dialogues.text: Ahem... And that's all Master Rhinedottir has to say. *coughs*...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good work, Sebas. Can't be easy being you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh. A cat that can imitate someone else's voice is just as strange to witness as the first time.

dialogues.speaker: Sebas
dialogues.text: Well, do not be so shocked. I am hardly an ordinary cat.

dialogues.speaker: Sebas
dialogues.text: In fact, from a biological standpoint, I am no cat at all, but rather, an alchemical being. You wouldn't consider yourself a Specter simply because you float in the air like one, surely...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A Specter? What are you trying to say, mister?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Oh, I know! Sebas is implying that you're—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe don't finish that thought, Durin.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What thought? Hey!

dialogues.speaker: Sebas
dialogues.text: Oh, and considering how Master Rhinedottir's message ended, I suppose this technique is useless now. I'll just destroy it.

dialogues.speaker: Sebas
dialogues.text: Few and far between are the people that can make her reconsider. Quite the impressive feat, young man.

dialogues.speaker: Sebas
dialogues.text: With that done, I'll be going now. I have another message to pass along. Perhaps we'll meet again sometime.

dialogues.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
dialogues.text: "This is the first time we're meeting, so I'm not sure how to address you. But since you're M's child, I suppose I'll stick with 'Mini Durin.'"

dialogues.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
dialogues.text: "Though you appear smaller than the Durin that came before you, that same strength flows through your veins — not a drop less."

dialogues.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
dialogues.text: "He was a child of 'Humus,' an incomplete creation. Thus, he lacked the 'will' to control his own strength."

dialogues.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
dialogues.text: "Yet this power was beyond what he could withstand, and so it twisted him, consumed him, thus sealing his ultimate fate."

dialogues.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
dialogues.text: "Albedo claims that you have transcended this tainted blood, becoming a being much like himself. That is his opinion. I remain unconvinced."

dialogues.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
dialogues.text: "I trust only the facts, only that which I 'see' for myself. So take this chance, child of M. Prove yourself to me."
Ahem... And that's all Master Rhinedottir has to say. *coughs*...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, could we get a self-introduction, at least?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! We're used to talking cats at this point, but one that can imitate someone else's voice... That's a first.

dialogues.speaker: Sebas
dialogues.text: I don't see how that's important, but if you must know... I am Sebas, a simple butler.

dialogues.speaker: Sebas
dialogues.text: You're friends of Albedo, yes? Strictly speaking, I am his "elder." So, make no mistake — I am no ordinary cat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We meet again, Sebas.

dialogues.speaker: Sebas
dialogues.text: Ahem. I have a message to deliver on Master Rhinedottir's behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Sebas
dialogues.text: Ahem...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, this is familiar.
Ahem. I have a message to deliver on Master Rhinedottir's behalf.
Ahem...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahhh! Where are we? Did this stupid dictionary transport us to some weird place again?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: My mom's scent... I sense it here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, here comes a strange cat!

dialogues.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
dialogues.text: "Hmm. Looks like Albedo wasn't mistaken after all."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Next time, maybe don't ambush us with a bunch of monsters just to prove a point!

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Still, I do feel like I can control my power more freely now that we've defeated them.

dialogues.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
dialogues.text: "After hearing about you, I prepared a technique that would seal the dark power in your blood. I had planned to take this opportunity to pass it on to you."

dialogues.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
dialogues.text: "Of course, using it comes with a price. While it would maintain your existence in Teyvat, it would also weaken your connection to this world."

dialogues.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
dialogues.text: "And you are M's child, when all is said and done. How could I allow that uncontrolled power to send you down the same path as the child who came before you?"

dialogues.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
dialogues.text: "But seeing you now, it appears my concerns were misplaced. M was a terrific mother, and a far more capable one than I."

dialogues.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
dialogues.text: "And I must admit, I'm rather curious to see how far you can go — how will you, an alchemical being truly integrated with this world, find your place in human society?"

dialogues.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
dialogues.text: "I've never conducted an experiment like this before. As such, you may yet hold the key to some unexpected answers."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! You've got one thing wrong there. Durin's not an experiment! He's our friend!

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: I'm not sure I understand, but... I appreciate your kindness, Aunt Rhinedottir.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahhh! Where did all these monsters come from!?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Is this the proof you need, Aunt Rhinedottir? Very well. I'll show you what I can do.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: The power within me is surging to the surface...

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: This is... getting easier!
